text.p: Singapore electronics company Asiamatrix Ltd said on Monday it will sell its lease on a factory together with machinery for Singapore $9.21 million to Chesfer Precision Plastic Pte Ltd, a plastics mould maker.

Asiamatrix said in a statement to the stock exchange the sale was in line with its plans to rationalise operations and it would use proceeds from the sale to repay bank borrowings and buy smaller premises.
The sale is conditional on the approval of the majority of the shareholders of the company and the Jurong Town Corp's agreement for the transfer of the premises, the statement said.
